creationInfo.comment: Generated from lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json, the files that fix this build. The `created` field is fixed rather than stamped so the document is a function of the release and two independent generations agree. The per-target link-time audit ships alongside as link-audit-<target>.txt.

packages.comment: Supplies the Lean runtime linked into every tl binary, and with it the statically linked GMP (LGPL-3.0-or-later, elected over the GPL-2.0 option) and libuv (MIT). See the licensing section of ADR-0006 and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.
packages.name: lean4

packages.comment: Statically linked via the Lean toolchain, not vendored by this project. tl elects the LGPL-3.0 option; the section 4 relink obligation is met by tl remaining open source with a pinned build system (ADR-0006).
packages.name: gmp

packages.comment: Statically linked into every Lean binary and omitted from Lean's own bundled LICENSES file, so tl's notice adds the entry itself.
packages.name: libuv

packages.comment: Lake dependency, pinned to an immutable commit (ADR-0009). Its license is classified fail-closed against the permissive allowlist by Tests/CliTests.lean and recorded in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.
